## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models fastvit-sa12_256x256
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target fastvit-sa12_256x256_sync   # once
./bin/fastvit-sa12_256x256_sync \
  -m assets/models/fastvit-sa12_256x256.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/image_classification/fastvit/fastvit-sa12_256x256/fastvit-sa12_256x256_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/fastvit-sa12_256x256.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```
